UPJ Psychology Study Program produces competent, empathetic graduates who are ready to face challenges. With a curriculum based on practice and theory, students are prepared to contribute in the clinical, industrial, and social fields. Industrial Psychology and Psychological Assessment are the leading fields of UPJ Psychology Study Program due to its closeness to Jaya Group as a source of practitioners as well as real practice returns for UPJ Psychology students. The advantages of UPJ Psychology study program with PT Pembangunan Jaya (Jaya Group) include industry-based curriculum, experienced lecturers, modern facilities (including psychology laboratories), and extensive networks with companies and professional institutions. Students can choose concentrations such as Industrial and Organizational Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Clinical Psychology, and Social Psychology.
Uniqueness
Our Psychology program stands out with three dynamic areas of focus:
What sets UPJ Psychology Program apart? We offer a dynamic, innovative approach that you'd be hard-pressed to find elsewhere.
Industrial Psychology AAAAAAAAA
Delve into the dynamics of the working world! Learn how psychological principles drive success in organizations and improve individual and team performance.
Basic Psychological Assessment
Quasi the art of diagnosing and understanding mental health. Our program equips you with the latest techniques to accurately assess psychological conditions.
Psychological Intervention
Be an agent of change! Explore strategies to change individual and community behavior, creating real impact in the lives of others.
Sustainable Accounting
Applying accounting principles for responsible business.
More Details
Join us and be part of a unique and dynamic Psychology program!

Bachelor of Psychology (S.Psi.)
13
Future Career
Graduates of UPJ Psychology Study Program have bright career prospects, such as:
Clinical Psychologist - Providing psychological assessment and intervention services.
HR Development Specialist - Managing and developing human resources.
Counselor - Helping individuals overcome psychological and emotional challenges.
Trainer - Provides personal and organizational development training.
Researcher - Develops scientific studies in the field of psychology.
Entrepreneur in Psychology - Building a business based on psychology knowledge.
Join UPJ Psychology and make your dreams come true!
UPJ - Where Future Psychologists are Shaped.
Alumni Testimonials
Studying Psychology at UPJ taught me to understand human behavior from different perspectives, while also fostering sensitivity and empathy in human interactions. Every course I took, whether core or elective, helped me see how psychology can be applied in real life. Various assignments, academic projects, and non-academic organizational experiences also sharpened my communication, self-management, and teamwork skills, all of which have been highly valuable in my professional journey. I am grateful that, despite its high academic standards, the Psychology program at UPJ always provides students with the space and opportunities to grow.
Thalia Lunaadhara Isril, S.Psi

Aries Yulianto, S.Psi., M.Si.
Lecturer & Departement Head
Aries has joined Universitas Pembangunan Jaya since July 2018 as a lecturer at Psychology Study Program and became the secretary of the Psychology Study Program in October 2018. Since July 2019 he has been the Head of the Psychology Study Program. The lectures he offered are Research Methodology and Statistics, Psychometrics, and Construction of Psychology Measurement Instruments. In addition to teaching, Aries is also experienced as a team for CPNS (civil servant selection tests) and SBMPTN-SNPTN selection (state universities entry tests), test developer for several governments and private institutions, as well as a resource person in training in the preparation of psychological measurement instruments and psychometric analysis. Besides lecturing, Aries also did several research studies on the preparation and analysis of psychological measuring instruments. The results of his research were widely presented in national and international seminars, as well as in the form of proceedings, journals, and books.

Ellyana Dwi Farisandy, M.Psi., Psikolog
Department Secretary & Lecturer
Ellyana Dwi Farisandy, M.Psi., Psikolog also known as Elly is a Clinical Psychologist and Lecturer Department of Psychology with over six years of clinical experience and four years in academia. She graduated cum laude with a Bachelor's degree in Psychology from Universitas Surabaya and earned her Master's degree in Professional Psychology from Universitas Airlangga, where she was recognized as the best graduate.
Her primary focus lies in clinical psychology, encompassing mental health, psychological disorders, and psychological interventions. Her expertise is further enhanced through participation in various Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) trainings and is supported by a certification in non-fiction writing competence from Badan Nasional Sertifikasi Profesi (BNSP).
Elly is an active writer and has published over 15 scientific articles in nationally accredited SINTA journals, as well as one article in an internationally reputable journal. Beyond her clinical and academic endeavors, she is frequently invited as a guest speaker in both offline and online settings, reflecting her commitment to bridging psychological science with the broader public.

Supriyanto, S.Psi., M.Si.
Lecturer & Psychodiagnostic laboratory Coordinator
Supriyanto joined Department of Psychology, Universitas Pembangunan Jaya in 2014 after completing his master degree in Social Intervention at the Faculty of Psychology, University of Indonesia. He obtained a bachelor's degree majoring in Psychology also from the Faculty of Psychology, University of Indonesia in 2004. Before pursuing his career as lecturer, Supriyanto had professional experience at the Ministry of Health (MoH) Republic of Indonesia, the American Red Cross and the Pulih Foundation. Based on the professional background from various national and international institutions, Supriyanto has gained a strong competence in the fields of community development, social intervention, program cycle management, monitoring and evaluation, social assessment, and training and development.
As a scholar, Supriyanto has a deep interest in Social Psychology, Community Psychology, Environmental Psychology and Urban Psychology. The classes he teaches includes: History of Psychology, Social Psychology, Community Psychology, Environmental Psychology, Urban Psychology, and Training and Development. His academic journey is marked by scientific publications in several topics such as tolerance, sense of community, social dominance orientation, social well-being, family satisfaction and social discrimination. Another regular activity related to his profession is social service.  Supriyanto has been involved in social service activities for more than 10 years as keynote speaker, training facilitator, and independent consultant.

Veronica Anastasia Melany, S.Psi., M.Si.
Lecturer & Scientific Coordinator
Vemmy, affectionately known as such, holds a bachelor's degree in psychology and a master's degree in applied psychology from the University of Indonesia. Before teaching at UPJ, she worked for a psychology bureau, a tax consultant, a non-profit organization, and a research institute. She has written parts of several books, such as Indonesian Families: Aspects and Dynamics of the Times and Advances in Urban Lifestyle and Technology. In addition, she has also published articles, both in national and international reputable journals.
Vemmy has a special interest in Social Psychology and Social Intervention, in line with her educational background. Therefore, until now, she not only teaches courses but also actively conducts research and consultations related to these two subjects. In addition, Vemmy is also active in providing training or seminars related to soft skills needed by the community, both inside and outside UPJ.

Bunga Karuni, M.Psi., Psikolog
Lecturer & Student affair Coordinator
Bunga, commonly known as Flo, is an Educational Psychologist and Psychology Lecturer with a strong passion for promoting mental health. She has extensive professional experience in education, training, and counselling students. Flo earned her Master’s degree in Psychology from Gadjah Mada University and graduated as the top student in her class from the Psychology Program at Pembangunan Jaya University in 2020 (Bachelor’s degree). Before joining Pembangunan Jaya University, she worked as a teaching assistant for psychology professional students at Gadjah Mada University, a position that enriched her teaching experience and allowed her to supervise academic projects for psychology students.
Her primary focus lies in the field of Educational Psychology. Flo continuously develops her expertise as a professional psychologist by providing structured interventions and counselling services to individuals ranging from children to adults who face mental health challenges. She is also an experienced keynote speaker at mental health seminars and training sessions, both in-person and online, where she shares her knowledge and advocates for the importance of psychological resilience in modern society.
Flo’s commitment to educational psychological intervention is further reflected in her development of an applicable growth mindset training module, specifically designed for adolescent students. Beyond her roles in practice and academia, Flo actively raises awareness about mental health on various social media platforms, with the aim of educating and inspiring not only students but also individuals from diverse backgrounds about the importance of mental health.

Gita W. L. Soerjoatmodjo, M.A., M.Psi., Psikolog
Lecturer and Head of the University Quality Assurance
Gita Widya Laksmini Soerjoatmodjo is a Psychologist and Lecturer with extensive experience in academia and organizational management. Currently, she serves as the Head of the Internal Quality Assurance (IQA) at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya.
Her professional journey spans roles as a journalist for Tempo Magazine and a correspondent in London before pursuing a Master's degree in Educational Psychology at Universitas Indonesia. This interdisciplinary experience enriches Gita’s approach to research and her commitment to applying psychology to improve the quality of life of urban communities through cross-sector collaboration.
Gita actively engages in research and publication, focusing on psychology and urban social issues. She has contributed to several books and international articles, including International Journalism and Democracy (Routledge, 2010) and Civil Society and Transparency in the Extractive Industry (Indonesian Parliamentary Center, 2015). Gita’s interest in psychological interventions in education and community development is reflected in her publications in national and international journals.

Dhindayanti Putri, S.Psi., M.Psi., Psikolog
Lecturer & Head of JCAL
Dhindayanti Putri is a Psychologist and Lecturer specializing in Industrial and Organizational Psychology, talent development, and organizational capability building. She holds a Professional Master’s Degree in Industrial and Organizational Psychology from Universitas Tarumanagara and a Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology from Universitas Pembangunan Jaya.
Currently, she serves as the Head of Jaya Center for Advanced Learning (JCAL) at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, leading learning strategy, leadership development, and workforce capability initiatives across the Jaya Group. Prior to this role, she worked at Grab Indonesia as a Behavioral Risk and Training Manager, where she managed assessment programs, training development, and safety and service quality initiatives for Driver Partners nationwide.
Her professional and academic interests include leadership development, psychological assessment, learning and development, behavioral risk management, and organizational effectiveness. Through her work, she is committed to bridging psychological science and organizational practice to create meaningful and sustainable impact.

Theresia Mustika W. H., M.Psi., Psikolog
Lecturer
Theresia Mustika W. H., commonly known as Tika, is a Clinical Psychologist specializing in adult mental health and a Psychology Lecturer with an interest in mental health and Health Psychology, particularly in how psychological factors shape health behaviors and contribute to individual well-being. She earned both her master’s degree in psychology and bachelor’s degree in psychology from Universitas Indonesia.
Tika’s research interests focus on Health Psychology, particularly health behavior, treatment adherence, and psychological distress in the context of chronic health conditions. Her master’s thesis examined the effectiveness of Motivational Interviewing in improving diabetes management adherence among patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. Alongside her clinical and research work, she is actively involved in psychology education and is committed to connecting psychological science with practical approaches to support health and well-being.

KUNJUNGAN LAPANGAN KE PUSAT KESEHATAN JIWA NASIONAL (PKJN) MARZOEKI MAHDI
Pada hari Selasa, 20 Mei 2025, Program Studi Psikologi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya melaksanakan kegiatan kunjungan lapangan ke Pusat Kesehatan Jiwa Nasional (PKJN) Marzoeki Mahdi di Jl. dr. Sumeru No. 114 Kota Bogor. Kegiatan ini diikuti oleh 111 mahasiswa yang tengah menempuh mata kuliah Psikologi Abnormal dan Psikodiagnostik.
Kegiatan diawali dengan sambutan dari Atik Puji Rahayu, S.Kep., Ners., M.Kep., Sp.Kep.J, selaku Kepala Instalasi Inovasi dan Pengembangan Pusat Kesehatan Jiwa Nasional (PKJN) Marzoeki Mahdi. Kunjungan ini dipandu oleh staf dari instansi tersebut, dengan pendampingan dari tiga dosen, yakni Bunga Karuni, M.Psi., Psikolog; Maria Jane Tienoviani Simanjuntak, M.Psi., Psikolog; dan Ellyana Dwi Farisandy, M.Psi., Psikolog, serta empat orang asisten dosen.
Mahasiswa memperoleh pemaparan mengenai sejarah dan layanan PKJN Marzoeki Mahdi, serta berkesempatan mengunjungi sejumlah bangsal. Dalam kunjungan tersebut, mahasiswa melakukan observasi dan wawancara langsung dengan staf maupun pasien terkait gangguan psikologis, asesmen psikologis, intervensi psikologis, dan penerapan pilar-pilar psikodiagnostik di fasilitas tersebut.
Kegiatan dilanjutkan dengan sesi pemaparan materi yang disampaikan oleh Armelia Rahmi Kartika Dini, S.Psi., Psikolog, salah satu psikolog dari PKJN Marzoeki Mahdi. Sesi ini diakhiri dengan diskusi dan tanya jawab yang berjalan secara interaktif dan antusias.
Melalui kunjungan lapangan ini, mahasiswa diharapkan dapat memperluas pemahaman teoretis dan praktis mengenai proses asesmen dan intervensi psikologis, serta memperoleh gambaran nyata mengenai penanganan gangguan psikologis di Pusat Kesehatan Jiwa Nasional (PKJN) Marzoeki Mahdi.

KUNJUNGAN AKADEMIK PROGRAM STUDI PSIKOLOGI UNIVERSITAS PEMBANGUNAN JAYA KE TAMAN IMPIAN JAYA ANCOL
Program Studi Psikologi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya melaksanakan kunjungan akademik ke Taman Impian Jaya Ancol pada Selasa, 25 November 2025, pukul 07.30–17.00 WIB, sebagai bagian dari learning journey mahasiswa tahun pertama. Kegiatan ini diikuti oleh 40 mahasiswa dari empat mata kuliah—Pengantar Psikologi, Psikologi Sosial, Perkembangan Anak dan Remaja, serta Penulisan Ilmiah—yang diampu oleh Ellyana Dwi Farisandy, M.Psi., Psikolog; Veronica A.M. Kaihatu, S.Psi., M.Si.; dan Hidayatul Annisa, M.Psi., Psikolog. Di Ecovention, peserta mengikuti sesi pemaparan mengenai sejarah pengembangan Ancol, struktur shareholders dan manajemen, visi dan misi perusahaan, serta berbagai unit bisnis yang dikelola PT Pembangunan Jaya Ancol. Materi ini disampaikan oleh Daniel Windriatmoko selaku Manager Corporate Communication PT PJA, dengan Resty Marintan Siallagan bertugas sebagai MC. Acara ini turut dihadiri oleh Jihan Nadia dari Corporate Communication dan Ariyadi Eko Nugroho, Manager Protokol.
Mahasiswa kemudian melakukan observasi lapangan di Pantai Pasir Putih, Ecopark, dan Pasar Seni. Pada setiap lokasi, mereka mengamati fenomena psikologis di ruang publik, seperti interaksi sosial, dinamika keluarga, perilaku anak dan remaja, serta motivasi pengunjung dalam konteks rekreasional. Observasi ini memberi pengalaman langsung mengenai bagaimana teori-teori psikologi dapat diamati dan dianalisis melalui perilaku nyata di lingkungan wisata yang beragam. Temuan lapangan selanjutnya diolah melalui diskusi dan diintegrasikan dalam bentuk refleksi akademik maupun artikel populer. Pendekatan learning-by-doing ini membantu mahasiswa memperkuat keterampilan analisis kritis, integrasi teori–praktik, serta membangun pemahaman awal mengenai profesionalisme dalam bidang psikologi. Kegiatan ini diharapkan dapat memperkaya wawasan mahasiswa mengenai penerapan psikologi dalam kehidupan sehari-hari sekaligus mendukung perkembangan kompetensi akademik mereka.

MDTV GOES TO CAMPUS WITH LA TAHZAN: CINTA, DOSA, LUKA :: Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ)
MDTV GOES TO CAMPUS WITH LA TAHZAN: CINTA, DOSA, LUKA
Program Studi Psikologi dan Ilmu Komunikasi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya bekerja sama dengan MDTV mengadakan acara promosi film “La Tahzan: Cinta, Dosa, Luka” yang dikaji dari sudut pandang psikologi dengan tema “The Anatomy of Betrayal: Understanding the Complexity of Infidelity” pada hari Selasa, 12 Agustus 2025, pukul 08.30–12.00 WIB, bertempat di Aula Lantai 3, Gedung B, Universitas Pembangunan Jaya. Acara ini menghadirkan lima pembicara dan dimoderatori oleh Naurissa Biasini, M.I.Kom., C.HT, selaku Kepala Program Studi Ilmu Komunikasi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya.
Pembicara pertama, Marshanda, yang memerankan tokoh Alina, membagikan pengalamannya dalam mempersiapkan peran tersebut, membahas cara menghadapi perselingkuhan dengan menerapkan teknik ADR (Admit & Aware, Detox, dan Reborn), serta bagaimana menjaga komunikasi dengan anak dalam konteks orang tua yang menghadapi perselingkuhan. Pembicara kedua, Elmand, yang memerankan Anggi, memberikan pandangan tentang bagaimana menghadapi situasi negatif dalam rumah tangga dengan menekankan pentingnya komunikasi dan praktik mindfulness. Pembicara ketiga, Dian Sasmita, selaku Associate Producer film La Tahzan, menjelaskan bahwa kisah film ini terinspirasi dari cerita seorang influencer bernama Eliza yang mengalami perselingkuhan. Tim produksi melakukan riset dasar, memodifikasi cerita, dan membangun struktur naratif yang kuat. Pembicara keempat, Astrid Suryatenggara, Chief Communication Officer dari MD Entertainment, menyampaikan bahwa tujuan MDTV adalah mengedukasi para ibu/perempuan yang mengalami situasi serupa melalui media hiburan (entertain to educate). Pembicara kelima, Maria Jane Tienoviani Simanjuntak, M.Psi., Psikolog, yang merupakan dosen di Program Studi Psikologi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, memaparkan dampak film terhadap peningkatan pengetahuan, langkah-langkah yang dapat dilakukan korban perselingkuhan, cara teman atau kerabat dekat memberikan dukungan, serta peran penonton film dalam proses ini.
Acara ini dihadiri oleh mahasiswa dan dosen dari Fakultas Humaniora dan Bisnis. Melalui kegiatan ini, mahasiswa diharapkan dapat memahami kompleksitas pengkhianatan dalam konteks perselingkuhan, mengetahui cara menghadapi perselingkuhan baik sebagai korban maupun sebagai orang terdekat, serta menyadari bahwa film dapat menjadi media yang memperkaya pengetahuan dan proses pembelajaran.
Penulis: Putri Sahira Bastari

STUDENT GATHERING PRODI PSIKOLOGI GASAL 2025-2026
Program Studi Psikologi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya menyelenggarakan student gathering untuk semester gasal tahun akademik 2025–2026 pada hari Selasa, 12 Agustus 2025, pukul 13.00 hingga 16.00 WIB, bertempat di Aula Lantai 3 Gedung B Universitas Pembangunan Jaya. Kegiatan ini merupakan agenda rutin yang diadakan setiap semester oleh Program Studi Psikologi. Sebanyak sepuluh dosen hadir dalam acara ini, yang dimoderatori oleh Angela Camila, mahasiswa Psikologi angkatan 2024.
Agenda dimulai dengan pemaparan oleh narasumber pertama, Aries Yulianto, S.Psi., M.Si., selaku Ketua Program Studi Psikologi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, yang membahas durasi masa studi mahasiswa, JSDP sebagai poin dan sebagai mata kuliah, serta Kode Etik 2025. Pembicara kedua, Maria Jane Tienoviani Simanjuntak, M.Psi., Psikolog, selaku Koordinator Keilmuan Program Studi Psikologi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, menjelaskan alur kurikulum 2019 dan 2023, serta membahas mengenai mata kuliah Regular+ 2025. Pembicara ketiga, Veronica Anastasia Melany, S.Psi., M.Si., Koordinator Kemahasiswaan Program Studi Psikologi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, memaparkan mengenai program Magang Berdampak dan konversi mata kuliah untuk program tersebut. Setelahnya, diskusi mengenai kebijakan skripsi dan proposal skripsi kembali disampaikan oleh Aries Yulianto, S.Psi., M.Si.
Acara ini juga menampilkan sesi PSY-AWARD, yaitu penghargaan bagi mahasiswa Psikologi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya yang berprestasi dalam berbagai kategori seperti tugas terbaik, perolehan poin JSDP tertinggi, serta IPK dan IPS tertinggi dan terbaik. Penghargaan ini diserahkan oleh Maria Jane Tienoviani Simanjuntak, M.Psi., Psikolog, Hidayatul Annisa, M.Psi., Psikolog, Dr. Clara Moningka, Gita W. L Soerjoatmodjo, M.A., M.Psi., Psikolog, Ellyana Dwi Farisandy, M.Psi., Psikolog, dan Supriyanto, S.Psi., M.Si. Selain itu, terdapat sesi permainan berhadiah yang dipandu oleh Bunga Karuni, M.Psi., Psikolog. Acara ditutup dengan sesi foto bersama antara dosen, mahasiswa berprestasi, dan seluruh mahasiswa Psikologi.
Kegiatan ini dihadiri oleh mahasiswa dari angkatan 2020 hingga 2024, dengan tujuan untuk memastikan seluruh mahasiswa Psikologi memahami struktur kurikulum, regulasi akademik terbaru, persiapan pengisian KRS, serta sebagai bentuk penghargaan atas kerja keras setiap mahasiswa.

Program Studi Psikologi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya menyelenggarakan kuliah umum bertajuk “Online Test Psikologi: Konsep dan Penerapannya dalam Industri” pada hari Kamis, 22 Mei 2025 pukul 13.00–16.00 WIB, bertempat di Teater 2, Lantai 4, Gedung A, Universitas Pembangunan Jaya. Kegiatan ini menghadirkan dua narasumber dari bidang psikologi industri dan desain digital.
Narasumber pertama, Firdhawati Khairunisa, S.Psi., yang menjabat sebagai Officer Manajemen Talenta di PT Jaya Real Property, membawakan materi berjudul “Pengembangan Online Test di PT JRP”. Dalam pemaparannya, beliau menjelaskan mengenai proses digitalisasi alat ukur psikologis di dunia industri, serta bagaimana teknologi dapat digunakan untuk meningkatkan aksesibilitas dan efisiensi dalam pelaksanaan evaluasi psikologis. Narasumber kedua, Muhammad Tafakur, S.Ds., M.Ds., Dosen Program Studi Desain Komunikasi Visual Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, menyampaikan materi berjudul “Prinsip Dasar UI/UX dalam Mendesain Online Test”. Beliau membahas secara mendalam tentang prinsip-prinsip desain antarmuka pengguna (UI) dan pengalaman pengguna (UX), serta pentingnya tipografi dalam mendukung keterbacaan dan kenyamanan pengguna saat mengakses tes psikologi secara daring. Acara ini dipandu oleh Aries Yulianto, S.Psi., M.Si., Dosen Program Studi Psikologi Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, dan diakhiri dengan sesi diskusi serta tanya jawab yang interaktif antara peserta dan narasumber.
Kuliah umum ini diikuti oleh mahasiswa Program Studi Psikologi yang sedang menempuh mata kuliah Psikometrika dan Konstruksi Alat Ukur Psikologis. Melalui kegiatan ini, diharapkan mahasiswa dapat memperdalam pemahaman mereka terkait pengembangan alat ukur psikologis berbasis digital serta memahami prinsip-prinsip desain UI/UX yang relevan dalam konteks online test.
